added.title: AI Engineering Lead- Director- Commercial Technology & Innovation
added.description:
The Opportunity

As an AI Engineering Lead, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will leverage advanced technologies and techniques to design and develop robust data solutions for clients. As a Director, you will set the strategic direction and lead business development efforts, making impactful decisions and overseeing multiple projects while maintaining executive-level client relations. You will inspire others to follow your vision, driving business growth and shaping the direction of client engagements.

In this role at PwC, you will apply data, algorithms, and software engineering to build and deploy software and platform systems that create Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning-based solutions at scale. Your work will involve designing AI systems, data wrangling, and software implementation to enable the AI models to be useful and scalable. You will be a guardian of PwC's reputation, understanding that quality, integrity, inclusion, and a commercial mindset are foundational to our success. You will cultivate the potential in others and actively collaborate across the PwC Network, leveraging our collective strength.

Responsibilities

Leading the design and deployment of AI systems to transform raw data into actionable insights
Overseeing the development of scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions using advanced technologies
Driving business growth by identifying market gaps and converting opportunities into successes
Mentoring and guiding teams in AI engineering to foster innovation and creativity
Collaborating with clients to shape the direction of AI-driven engagements and solutions
Promoting technological advances to create environments where people and technology thrive together
Managing complex data analysis and integration to support AI model implementation
Utilizing programming languages such as Python and Java to enhance AI system capabilities
Implementing data infrastructure and quality measures to support robust AI solutions
Encouraging systemic thinking and rapid experimentation to solve complex problems creatively

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 9 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Analytics/Data Science, Artificial Intelligence/Robotics, Computer Science/Information Systems, Engineering
At least one of the following: Certifications aligned to data engineering, machine learning, and cloud platforms, including AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, or related data and AI credentials
Leading AI implementation projects with a focus on innovation
Utilizing advanced machine learning libraries like TensorFlow and Scikit-Learn
Developing complex data models and pipelines for analytics
Excelling in programming languages such as Python and C++
Driving thought leadership in artificial intelligence and data science

The salary range for this position is: $155,000 - $410,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits-at-a-glance

As PwC is an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at PwC without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity); age; disability; genetic information (including family medical history); veteran, marital, or citizenship status; or, any other status protected by law. 

PwC does not intend to hire experienced or entry level job seekers who will need, now or in the future, PwC sponsorship through the H-1B lottery, except as set forth within the following policy: https://pwc.to/H-1B-Lottery-Policy.

Learn more about how we work: https://pwc.to/how-we-work

For only those qualified applicants that are impacted by the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, San Diego County Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable, arrest or conviction records will be considered for Employment in accordance with these laws. At PwC, we recognize that conviction records may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship to responsibilities such as accessing sensitive company or customer information, handling proprietary assets, or collaborating closely with team members. We evaluate these factors thoughtfully to establish a secure and trusted workplace for all.

added.title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Web Experience
added.description:
About The Team/Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Mobility Web Experience Engineering organization responsible for delivering high-quality web applications and experiences that serve thousands of mobility customer interactions. You will lead an engineering team, build a strong engineering culture, and partner closely with Product, Design, Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure teams to deliver exceptional web experiences.

This role requires a leader who is passionate about developing people, driving engineering excellence, and executing large-scale initiatives while balancing speed, quality, and operational reliability.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Define, own, and execute the long-term engineering strategy for the WEX Mobility Web Experience, including card and vehicle management, mobility payments, and future web platform capabilities.
Partner with architects and technical leaders to define the technical vision and architecture for the web platform.
Develop and maintain the engineering roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities and industry best practices.
Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, collaboration, ownership, and operational excellence.
Continuously improve engineering processes to increase delivery velocity, quality, and developer productivity.
Lead complex cross-functional engineering initiatives from planning through execution, driving alignment across teams and stakeholders.
Partner closely with Product, UX, and business leaders to prioritize investments and deliver customer-centric web experiences.
Establish and monitor engineering metrics that improve delivery predictability, quality, reliability, and team effectiveness.
Drive effective planning, execution, and continuous improvement through regular operating mechanisms, including sprint planning, roadmap reviews, and operational reviews.
Partner with Product and business leaders to maintain a healthy roadmap and define measurable objectives and key results (OKRs).
Collaborate across Mobility engineering teams to promote reusable platforms, shared components, and engineering best practices.
Hire, develop, mentor, and retain high-performing engineering managers and software engineers.
Provide regular coaching, performance feedback, and career development to help team members reach their full potential.
Manage team capacity and staffing to ensure successful delivery of strategic priorities.
Communicate engineering strategy, progress, risks, and opportunities effectively to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.

Experience You'll Bring

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of software engineering experience.
4+ years of engineering management experience leading software engineering teams.
Experience leading the development and delivery of modern, scalable web applications using frameworks such as Angular or React, and micro-frontend (MFE) architectures.
Strong understanding of modern web architectures, including single-page applications and micro-frontend patterns, application lifecycle management, and software engineering best practices.
Strong communication, organizational, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.
Solid understanding of security, privacy, authentication, authorization, and data protection principles for web applications.
Experience leveraging automation, AI-assisted development tools, and engineering productivity practices to improve quality and delivery velocity.
Strong people leadership skills, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development for web engineering teams.
Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments, make thoughtful trade-offs, and lead teams through organizational and technical change.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience using analytics and customer insights to inform product and engineering decisions and improve user experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Angular, React, or other modern web development technologies, as well as experience with Micro-frontend (MFE) architectures.
Experience building shared web platforms, component libraries, reusable frameworks, or design systems.
Experience building high-performance distributed systems at internet-scale companies.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, release automation, feature flag platforms, and web performance monitoring and observability.
Experience developing payment, fleet, financial technology (FinTech), or commercial card solutions.
Experience integrating with payment networks or card schemes.
Experience working with closed-loop or proprietary payment systems.

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.

added.title: Vice President of Software Engineering - Remote
added.description:
The Vice President of Software Engineering is part of the Chief Information Technology Office, which resides on the Engineering Leadership team and reports to the Chief Information Officer. As our Vice President of Software Engineering, you will be responsible for leading the CIS Software Engineering teams that develop and support our products and internal infrastructure. The Vice President of Software Engineering provides technical leadership, including managing and mentoring software engineering personnel, guiding software development practices in leveraging state-of-the art practices and tools including leveraging AI-enabled practices, ensuring architectural standards compliance, fostering rapid, agile development and high-quality delivery, and aligning technology solutions with business objectives. This role oversees a portfolio of mission-driven engineering efforts and ensures alignment with organizational goals, user needs, and evolving technologies. The VP of Software Engineering empowers high-performing teams, drives engineering excellence, and ensures that CIS products and services consistently deliver exceptional value, reliability, and impact.

What You'll Do

Provide hands-on technical leadership for Software Engineering teams, serving as a trusted expert in software architecture, engineering best practices, modern development frameworks, cloud platforms, security, DevOps, and AI-enabled software development
Lead the end-to-end agile software development lifecycle, leveraging AI-driven tools and practices, to rapidly deliver incremental capabilities aligned with user needs and expectations
Drive the adoption of modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development, automated testing, code quality analysis, intelligent code reviews, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and cloud-native development methodologies
Actively mentor and develop engineers through technical coaching, architecture reviews, code reviews, and the adherence to engineering standards and best practices
Lead the evaluation, implementation, and governance of AI technologies and tools, ensuring effective, secure, and responsible use throughout the software development process
Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, innovation, accountability, and data-driven decision-making within Software Engineering and User Experience teams
Collaborate closely with end users, business stakeholders, product owners, architects, cybersecurity teams, and Operational Support teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with organizational objectives
Establish and measure engineering performance through meaningful metrics, including product quality, software delivery effectiveness, system reliability, team productivity, AI adoption outcomes, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency
Identify technical, operational, and product risks early, leveraging data, engineering insights, and AI-assisted analysis to proactively develop mitigation strategies and ensure successful delivery
Recruit, build, and lead high-performing Engineering teams; attracting and retaining top technical talent while creating clear pathways for technical growth and leadership development
Serve as the primary advocate for engineering excellence, continuous modernization, and AI-enabled innovation across CIS products and platforms
Other tasks and responsibilities as assigned

What You'll Need

Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field*
15+ years of progressive technical experience in software engineering
7+ years of leadership experience, managing software development teams implementing agile methods and leveraging AI tools
Experience defining software architecture and design standards
Experience in effectively leveraging AI into the full software development life cycle
Proven success leading software development organizations using agile methods
Experience in reviewing and approving technical designs
Experience establishing coding standards and best practices
Ability to make and influence decisions on technology and platform selections with an emphasis on software quality, maintainability, and scalability
Experience leading modernization and technical debt reduction efforts
Proven success leading remote and distributed teams with the ability to provide technical mentorship to developers
Ability to proactively evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends
Experience in the acquisition of software products and services as well as integration of third-party software products
Exceptional leadership, project management, and communication skills
Demonstrated business acumen with experience developing and managing departmental budgets
Ability to translate mission objectives into measurable engineering outcomes
Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with attention to detail
Must be authorized to work in the United States

It's a Plus If You Have

Advanced degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline
Experience implementing or operating knowledge graph technologies
Additional years of relevant experience or a combination of an Associate’s degree or equivalent and relevant experience may be substituted for the Bachelor’s degree.

At CIS, we are committed to providing an inclusive environment in which the diverse backgrounds, experiences, and views of our employees, members, and customers are valued and respected. It is through this commitment that we are able to work together towards our common mission: to make the connected world a safer place.

Compensation Range

USD$191,100.00 - $344,000.00

added.title: Director, Engineering
added.description:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Director, Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, delivery, modernization, and ongoing support of enterprise technology solutions that enable the firm’s legal and business operations.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership for software engineering, application development, and systems integration, and engineering delivery functions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable and aligned with enterprise and value stream priorities.

The Director, Engineering partners closely with value stream leadership, IT services leaders, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality technology capabilities that improve attorney and business professional productivity, enhance client experience, and support revenue growth and operational efficiency.

This role is accountable for engineering execution discipline, technical quality, delivery reliability, and the evolution of reusable engineering and platform capabilities that accelerate the firm's transition to a build-capable technology organization.

Location

This position can sit in any of our U.S. offices and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

Provide strategic leadership for engineering and application development teams supporting firmwide legal and business capabilities across value streams.
Set technical direction, architectural standards, and engineering practices to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable, and operationally sustainable.
Partner closely with IT, legal operations, and business stakeholders to translate business outcomes and value stream priorities into executable technology roadmaps and engineering delivery strategy, keeping a user experience and product value mindset at the forefront.
Lead engineering execution and continuous delivery of technology capabilities, balancing innovation, platform stability, technical debt reduction, risk management, and operational excellence.
Collaborate across IT functions to improve delivery flow, reduce bottlenecks, and increase engineering throughput and reliability.
Oversee engineering efforts across multiple product and platform workstreams, balancing innovation, operational stability, quality, risk, and delivery commitments.
Establish and promote engineering best practices including automation, CI/CD, observability, resiliency, testing, reusable engineering capabilities, and operational readiness.
Manage engineering budgets, vendor relationships, consultant resources, and third-party development partners as applicable to the success of the service portfolio and deliverables.
Lead, develop, and retain engineering management and senior technical talent, including performance management and succession planning.
Establish governance, metrics, and reporting for engineering performance, platform health, technical debt, operational sustainability, and delivery outcomes.
Ensure compliance with firm security, risk, governance, privacy, and data protection standards across all engineering activities.
Partner with infrastructure, operations, SRE, and end-user support teams to ensure stable production operations and smooth lifecycle support for delivered capabilities.
Provides leadership to and manages a team of business professionals to include coaching, mentoring and professional development. Responsible for providing performance feedback on a regular basis.

Desired Skills

Enterprise application architecture and modern development practices. Strategic planning and execution in complex environments. People leadership and organizational development. Financial and vendor management. Stakeholder partnership and executive communication. Risk management, security awareness, and operational excellence.

Minimum Education

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree in Technology, business, or management‑related discipline.

Certifications

Relevant certifications in cloud platforms, architecture, or technology leadership are preferred.

Minimum Years Of Experience

10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering or application development, including at least five years in a senior leadership or management role overseeing multiple teams or portfolios.

Essential Job Expectations

While the specific job requirements of a DLA Piper position may vary depending upon scope of the job and area of specialty, there are certain universal requirements that are expected of all DLA Piper employees, which include but are not limited to:

Effectively communicate, verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and third parties;
Produce deliverables, answer phone calls, and reply to correspondence in an efficient and responsive manner;
Provide timely, accurate, and quality work product;
Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required;
Foster positive work relationships;
Comply with all firm policies and practices;
Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed;
Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment;
Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.   

Work Environment   

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement comprised of remote and in-office work, the requirement for which will be determined in coordination with the hiring manager or supervisor and may be modified in the firm’s discretion in the future.

Disclaimer   

The purpose of this job description is to provide a concise statement of the work elements and to organize and present the information in a standardized way. It is not intended to describe all the elements of the work that may be performed by every individual in this classification, nor should it serve as the sole criteria for personnel decisions and actions. The job duties, requirements, and expectations for this position may be modified at the Firm’s discretion at any time. This job description does not change the at-will nature of employment.

Application Process    

Applicants must apply directly online instead of sending application materials via email.

Accommodation   

Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to permit individuals with a disability to perform the essential functions and responsibilities of the position or to participate in the job selection process. If you have a request for an accommodation during the application process, please contact careers@us.dlapiper.com.

Agency applications will not be considered.    

No immigration sponsorship is available for this position.   

The firm’s expected hiring range for this position is $168,478 - $272,949 depending on the candidate’s geographic market location.

The compensation offered for employment will also be dependent on other factors including the candidate’s experience, skills, educational and professional background, and overall qualifications. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including medical/dental/vision insurance, and 401(k).

Applicants who are not based in the jurisdiction in which this position is posted and who apply for this role are doing so voluntarily and are not eligible for relocation assistance. Any relocation benefits, if any, are provided only where a relocation is required at the firm’s direction and in accordance with applicable policy and law.

DLA Piper is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Job applicant poster viewing center .
